item.title: Improving (analysis) process: developing packages
item.description:
I was invited to give this talk shortly after my talk at useR!2021. I was very nervous because I would like to have such a community on Spain and work together with them.

I presented a about how R can be used on the public medical sector to enhance and improve analysis and their reproducibility.
